name: Backblaze
description_en:
Backblaze Computer Backup runs on a Mac or Windows computer and continuously copies eligible local files and selected directly attached drives to the cloud. It is file protection for a licensed computer, with historical versions governed by retention settings. It is not a bootable disk image.

Backblaze also sells B2 Cloud Storage, an object-storage service with a different usage model. This profile focuses on Computer Backup and explains why “unlimited” capacity must be read alongside exclusions, retention and service terms. No client or recovery was tested.
description_zh:
Backblaze Computer Backup 在 Mac 或 Windows 电脑上运行，持续把符合条件的本地文件和所选直连硬盘复制到云端。它按获许可电脑保护文件，历史版本受保留设置约束，不是可启动的整盘镜像。

Backblaze 还销售 B2 Cloud Storage 对象存储，使用与计费模式不同。本文重点介绍 Computer Backup，说明为何“无限容量”必须结合排除项、保留期和服务条款理解，未实际测试客户端或恢复。

sections.title_en: Check what is eligible before the first upload
sections.title_zh: 首次上传前确认备份资格
sections.en:
The current Supported Backup Data page excludes operating-system and application files, network-mounted storage, NAS, symlinks and other specified locations or types. It describes retrying locked files later and exposing skipped files through client reports. Cloud-mounted folders can also be excluded, as the Mac release notes explain.

For a photographer with local originals and a NAS archive, the local eligible files and NAS require separate consideration. Do not accept the homepage’s broad “every file” wording as evidence that a particular folder is protected. Inspect its actual eligibility and recover a sample.
sections.zh:
当前 Supported Backup Data 页面排除操作系统及应用文件、网络挂载存储、NAS、符号链接，以及其他指定位置或类型。文档说明锁定文件稍后重试，并可在客户端报告查看跳过文件。Mac 发布说明还记载了云挂载目录排除。

例如，摄影师同时持有本地原片和 NAS 档案时，应分别处理这两类来源。不能把首页笼统的“每个文件”视为某个目录受保护的证据，应检查实际资格并恢复样例。

sections.title_en: A backup is not permanent extra disk space
sections.title_zh: 备份不是永久扩展硬盘
sections.en:
Version History retains modified or deleted file versions for the selected period. Documentation distinguishes 30 days, one year and Forever; one-year history is available without additional storage cost, while Forever has additional charges for older retained versions. Confirm the setting on the actual backup.

Increasing retention does not recover versions already purged. Decreasing it immediately removes access beyond the shorter window. Disconnected drives may require selecting an older date in the restore interface. For example, deleting a local archive to free space is a retention event, not a safe instruction to keep its cloud copy indefinitely.
sections.zh:
Version History 按所选期限保存已修改或删除的文件版本。文档区分 30 天、一年和 Forever；一年历史无额外存储费，Forever 对更旧的保留版本另收费。应核对实际备份的设置。

延长保留期无法找回已清除版本；缩短后立即无法访问新窗口以外的版本。断开的硬盘可能需要在恢复界面选择旧日期才能看到。例如，为腾空间删除本地档案，会触发保留期问题，不能当作永久保留云副本的安全做法。

sections.title_en: Choose a restore path that fits the loss
sections.title_zh: 按丢失范围选择恢复方式
sections.en:
The product and pricing pages describe a dedicated restore application, web ZIP downloads and mailed USB-drive recovery. The listed web ZIP limit is 500 GB per request, with multiple requests possible. The mailed-drive refund requires returning the drive within 30 days; shipping and actual order conditions should be checked before relying on it.

For a few accidentally overwritten files, choose the correct historical date and recover to another location before comparing contents. A failed computer also needs its operating system and applications restored through other means. Initial upload and a large download are limited by the available connection; no recovery-time promise was measured here.
sections.zh:
产品与定价页列出专用恢复应用、网页 ZIP 下载和邮寄 USB 硬盘恢复。网页 ZIP 每次请求上限为 500 GB，可准备多个请求；邮寄盘退款要求 30 天内归还，依赖该方式前还应检查物流及实际订单条件。

少量文件被覆盖时，应选择正确历史日期，恢复到另一位置后比较内容。电脑故障还需要通过其他方式恢复操作系统和应用。首次上传及大量下载受连接速度限制，本文没有测量恢复时限。

sections.title_zh: 统计电脑数量及保留选项
sections.en:
The retrieved Computer Backup pages advertise USD 9 per month, USD 99 per year, or USD 189 for two years for a computer license. Business adds group administration; Enterprise Control is quote-led. A 15-day trial is described on the personal page. Forever retention and mailed-drive ordering have separate conditions.

A hypothetical two-computer household choosing the USD 99 annual license pays USD 198 per year before tax or extras; this is arithmetic, not a checkout quote. Terms describe automatic subscription renewal at then-current prices. The 2026 terms also reserve action for disproportionate resource use, so “unlimited” is scoped to intended computer-backup use.
sections.zh:
本次 Computer Backup 页面列出单电脑许可每月 9 美元、每年 99 美元或两年 189 美元。Business 增加群组管理，Enterprise Control 询价；个人页列有 15 天试用。Forever 保留和邮寄盘另有条件。

假设两台家用电脑均选 99 美元年付，税费及附加项前合计每年 198 美元；这是算例，并非结账报价。条款规定按届时价格自动续费。2026 年条款还保留对不成比例资源使用采取措施的权利，因此“无限”受预期电脑备份用途约束。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the files that would hurt to lose
sections.title_zh: 用最不能丢的文件评估
sections.en:
Install the correct client for a supported system, inspect excluded and skipped locations, select attached drives and retention, and wait for the initial eligible upload to finish. Then restore representative files, including an earlier version. Store account recovery information and any optional private key through an appropriate process.

Shortlist Computer Backup for automatic off-site protection of eligible workstation files. NAS protection, server workloads, bare-metal recovery and cloud-storage integration need a different scoped design. Read a matching client release’s exclusions instead of assuming old advice remains valid. These are selection and acceptance suggestions, not a performance or security assessment.
sections.zh:
应为受支持系统安装正确客户端，检查排除和跳过位置，选择直连硬盘与保留期，等待首次符合条件的上传结束。之后恢复代表性文件，包括旧版本；通过合适流程保存账户恢复资料及可选私钥。

需要自动异地保护工作站合格文件时，可考虑 Computer Backup。NAS、服务器、裸机恢复和云存储集成需要另行明确方案。排除项应按匹配客户端版本检查，不能假定旧建议始终适用。以上为选型及验收建议，未开展性能或安全评估。
